999008199.text: どうだ？　ケイウン料理は口に合ったか？

localizations.en: So, how was it? Did the Keiun cuisine suit your tastes?

999008199.text:
はい、最初は驚いたりしましたけど
どれもとっても美味しいです！

localizations.en: Yes, I was surprised at first, but everything was absolutely delicious!

999008199.text: そうかそうか。それは何より！

localizations.en: Excellent, excellent! That's wonderful to hear!

999008199.text:
……で、だ。そろそろ見せてもらいたい。
はは、うずうずしていてな

localizations.en: ...Now then. I'd like to see what you've brought. Haha, I'm practically bursting with curiosity.

999008199.text:
はい、錬金術の品物ですね！
少し音が出ますし、広くて人気のない所は……

localizations.en: Of course, the alchemical goods! It might get noisy, so somewhere spacious and away from people would be...

999008199.text:
おお、では城内の修練場へと案内しよう。
こちらだ

localizations.en: Ah, then I'll guide you to the training grounds within the castle. This way.

999008199.text:
さすが姉様……美味しいご飯を食べても仕事、
忘れていない

localizations.en: Even after a delicious meal, she never forgets about work. That's just like you!

999008199.text:
アルビちゃんは、そういうしっかり者で
売り込んでるから

localizations.en: I've got my reputation to uphold.

999008199.text: ……コウセンという人はこの中にいないみたいね

localizations.en: ...That Kosen person doesn't seem to be among them.

999008199.text:
永遠さんから聞いた人相の人はいませんよね……
とはいえ、下手に聞いたら怪しまれますし……

localizations.en: No one matching the description Towa gave us... Though asking around carelessly would just make us look suspicious...

999008199.text: どうした、早くしないと置いていくぞー

localizations.en: What's keeping you? Hurry up or I'll leave you behind!

999008199.text: は、はい！　ただいま！
ここならどうだ？　兵士たちが稽古する場だが

localizations.en: How about here? It's where the soldiers practice their drills.

999008199.text:
はい、問題ありません。
では早速、取り出したるは……クラフトです！

localizations.en: Perfect! Now then, what I'm about to show you is... a Craft!

999008199.text: ふむ……？　これはどう使うのだ？

localizations.en: Hmm...? How exactly do you use this?

999008199.text: これをこうして投げると……ちょあっ！

localizations.en: You throw it like this and... whoa!

999008199.text:
おお、修練用の木人が粉々ではないか！
これは素晴らしい！

localizations.en: Amazing! The training dummy is completely obliterated! This is magnificent!

999008199.text:
（永遠さんとの打ち合わせ通り、
　派手な爆発をする道具に食いついたわね……）

localizations.en: (Just as we planned with Towa—she's completely enamored with the explosive device...)

999008199.text:
この武器が量産できれば、戦や発掘にも
大いに活用できそうだ！　なあ、千歳！

localizations.en: If this weapon could be mass-produced, it would be incredibly useful for both warfare and excavation! Don't you think so, Chitose?

999008199.text: はい……でも、少し、怖いです……

localizations.en: Yes... but it's a little... frightening...

999008199.text:
錬金術は怖いものだけじゃないですよ。
たとえばこれ……ゴルトアイゼン

localizations.en: Alchemy isn't all scary things, you know. For example, this... Goldoterion.

999008199.text:
それは金塊か？　その程度ならこの城にも……
いや、待て、なんだこの純度は……！

localizations.en: Is that a gold ingot? We have plenty of those in this castle... No, wait. What is this purity...!

999008199.text:
ケイウンの冶金ではこのように鮮やかな金塊は造れん。
これだけで錬金術が優れているのが分かる……！

localizations.en: Keiun's metallurgy could never produce such a brilliant gold ingot. This alone shows how superior alchemy is...!

999008199.text:
（光りモノも好き……情報通り……
　最後にとどめのひと押し……）

localizations.en: (She likes shiny things too... just like the intel said... Time for the final push...)

999008199.text:
これは生きてる荷車です。一定の場所を往復します。
荷物運びに便利なんですよ

localizations.en: This is a living cart. It travels back and forth between set locations. It's very handy for carrying cargo.

999008199.text:
なんと、勝手に動く荷車など初めて見た！
なぁ、千歳！

localizations.en: Incredible! I've never seen a cart that moves on its own! Look at this, Chitose!

999008199.text: はい、かわいいです

（ケイウンの人もなじみがある荷車なら
　生きてる道具の中でも受け入れやすいよね……！）

localizations.en: (Since carts are familiar to people in Keiun, they should be more accepting of this living tool than others...!)

999008199.text:
いいものを見せてもらったぞ
錬金術の素晴らしさ、面白さ……よく伝わった！

localizations.en: You've shown me wonderful things. The brilliance and fascination of alchemy... it comes through perfectly!

999008199.text: 喜んでいただけて恐縮です！

お前たちの持ってきた商品、すべて言い値で買おう！
場合によっては追加で注文したい！

localizations.en: I'll buy all the goods you've brought at your asking price! And depending on the situation, I'd like to place additional orders!

999008199.text: はい！
それとお前たちの武を見せてもらいたい！

localizations.en: And I'd like to see your martial prowess!

999008199.text: はい！
……はい？

海の彼方より魔物を切り伏せやって来たその力を、
腹ごなしに見せてもらいたくなった

localizations.en: That strength that carried you across the seas, cutting down monsters along the way—I'd like to see it as a bit of after-dinner entertainment.

999008199.text: え、でもそんな、危ないですよ！

localizations.en: Oh, but that would be dangerous!

999008199.text:
安心しろ。余興だ、余興！
……それとも何か？

localizations.en: Don't worry. It's just for fun! Maybe...

999008199.text: 余に、かなうとでも？

localizations.en: Do you think you can best me?

999008199.text:
（想定外の展開だけど……でも、鏑矢さんの場合
　きっと強い人のほうが認めてくれるよね）

localizations.en: (This isn't part of the plan, but... knowing Kaburaya, she'd probably respect strength.)

999008199.text:
わ、分かりました！
その胸、どーんとお借りします！

localizations.en: A-all right! We'll take you up on that challenge!

999008199.text: よし。では千歳、お前も共に行くぞ

localizations.en: Excellent. Chitose, you'll join me as well.

999008199.text:
はい。鏑矢様が仰るのなら。
皆様、よろしくお願いいたします

localizations.en: Yes. If you wish it, Lady Kaburaya. Everyone, please go easy on us.

999008199.text:
ただの巫女と思って甘く見ないほうがいい。
余の臣下として、武芸の心得もあるからな

localizations.en: Don't underestimate her just because she's a shrine maiden. As one of my retainers, she's well-versed in martial arts too.

999008199.text: ……では、戦おう！
